text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: A fangirl's gotta be ready, always. Which is why I'm currently awake and dressed at 5:00 a.m.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer! I'm so... SO
excited for today!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Anyone'd be pumped for a
pilgrimage to oshi sites!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Each Umamusume has their own life story...
their own unique legend. And today, we're
going to follow those journeys through a
series of
historic locations.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ideally,
I would've wanted at least a month
for the tour, but I've got
my own races to
run, so today's gonna be jam-packed!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So little time, so many oshis. Now,
let's get
this show on the road!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Here we are! Well, almost. We're here for
the flower field over there.
It's called the
Restful Garden... by me anyways.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's said that the flowers here have
symbolic meanings, which
Umamusume use
to confess their true, secret feelings.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
In particular,
there are several stories of
Umas exchanging clovers
with their
closest, dearest rival!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And do you know what clovers mean?
"Think of me"! "Promise"! They're
promising to have each other in their
hearts forever and ever
and everrr!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I. KNOW. RIGHT?! Their feelings run
deeper than the Mariana
Trench!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
For our next stop—behold the Park of
Sisterly Races!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now, this story's actually about Hayahide.
It's said that she used to
race her little
sister Brian when they were kids.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Imagine having your own sister as your rival. Just think what it'd be like running around here together... Doesn't it inspire you to run too?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Do I ever! Following their footsteps will
bring me that much closer to them in
spirit—
that's the best part of being a simp!
Let's goooo!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...Mmm ahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: O. M. G! This "Ramen of Champions" is everything!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's so good! And, uh... it sure is
champion-sized!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
N-not just anyone,
could conquer... this...
much... uuugh...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'm fine! Countless challengers have taken this seat, putting their life on the line to take the champion's crown. I have to know... what they felt when... they...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Urp...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We power our way through stop after stop
on Digital's simp
pilgrimage until...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
We did it! That honeyade stand was the
final stop on our route. What
a day!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No kidding! For real,
thanks for sticking it
out for the whole trip! o7

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, also... Hehe. This was a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I was originally planning to go by myself,
you know. But...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And that's the pilgrimage, all mapped out!
Muhuhwa. ☆ I'm gonna
talk Trainer's ear
off when I get back. ♪

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what do you even mean,
"pilgrimage"? But sounds like you're
gonna
have a blast!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! D-did you uh… hear all that? Sorry
for being loud!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Aaanyways, what about your trainer,
though? They're not going with
you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait! I-I honestly never thought of that.
Me and Trainer... simping
together?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Nnn?
NNAAASDFSKJAHLAKLLJASDLA?!!?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And what would you know? Going out with
other people is actually
really,
reeeeeeally—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: REEEEALLY FUN!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to hear it!
I wasn't sure if you'd
even agree to come, seeing as
it was such
an early start on your day off.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It was so worth it though!
I feel like I've
just unlocked some huge
secret life hack!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I legit can't believe I never thought of
this.
The two of us can simp
together for
double the fun!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I'm still really blown away
by the fact that there's
someone on this
planet who actually even likes the same
stuff I do!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No it's not! As I'm sure you've noticed, I
tend to go waaay overboard
with this stuff.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Barely anyone can keep up with the otaku
talk, let alone join in on it!
You have no
idea how rare a fellow Uma simp is!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But now whenever the feels hit hard, I get
so excited to share the
good news with
you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-you, you really mean it?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Always?! You're sure??!? You're reeeally
sure???!?!1? Because you're
about to
unleash the floodgates of my ota—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: HOLD THAT THOOOUGHT!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Look. Over there. Is that...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet?! See? Over by
the bridge? It seems like
they're arguing
over something.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Could this...
could this be the birth of
a new legend?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, don't just stand there! We've gotta
hurry! Go, go, go, GO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I can get a word in, Digital takes
off to get a good view. For
lack of a better
plan, I chase after her for one more round
of "simping."
